commons.title: Maroon Art - Museum - Nieuw Amsterdam (23624931402).jpg
commons.description: Example of art by the Saramaka tribe. They escaped from the Portuguese and speak the Saramaka language (a Portuguese creole). Their art is almost exclusively carvings.
commons.editorial_reason: Description explicitly attributes the carved object to the Saramaka, and the image visibly shows their traditional carving art.
